gloss: a glance; one look; at first sight

examples.japanese: {一目|ひとめ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{分|わ}かった→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
{一目|ひとめ}⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{気|き}に{入|い}った→気に入る：02047_kiniiru⟧。
examples.english: I liked it the moment I saw it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{一目|ひとめ}{惚|ぼ}れ⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I fell in love with her at first sight.
I want to see her, even if only for a moment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{富士山|ふじさん}→富士山：09514_fujisan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一目|ひとめ}⟦{見|み}よう→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{乗客|じょうきゃく}→乗客：03284_joukyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: Passengers crowded to the window to catch a glimpse of Mount Fuji.

examples.japanese: {一目|ひとめ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{本物|ほんもの}→本物：03628_honmono⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{分|わ}かった→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: I could tell at a glance that it was genuine.

notes:
PRONUNCIATION:
Several set phrases read the same kanji いちもく:
- ⟦{一目瞭然|いちもくりょうぜん}→一目瞭然：06377_ichimokuryouzen⟧: perfectly clear at a glance
- {一目|いちもく}⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧: to acknowledge someone's superiority, to hold in respect
- ⟦{一目散|いちもくさん}→一目散：08954_ichimokusan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{逃|に}げる→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧: to flee at full speed

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {一目|ひとめ}{惚|ぼ}れ: love at first sight
- {一目|ひとめ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧: to understand at a glance
- {一目|ひとめ}⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to take one look

WATCH OUT:
"The eyes of others" is a different word with the same reading, ⟦{人目|ひとめ}→人目：17973_hitome⟧: ⟦{人目|ひとめ}→人目：17973_hitome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{気|き}にする→気にする：03026_kinisuru⟧ (to care what people think), ⟦{人目|ひとめ}→人目：17973_hitome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧ (to avoid being seen).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一見|いっけん}→一見：17699_ikken⟧: at first glance, apparently (a superficial impression that may be wrong)
